entities.name: PMID:10752962
observations: Weller et al. studied human RPE cells seeded onto bovine retinal explants; retinal-area contraction was measured after 7 days.
Untreated RPE-seeded explants contracted by more than 50%.
IL-10 reduced contraction by 63% versus untreated controls.
Neutralizing antibodies against PDGF and/or TGF-beta2 reduced contraction by up to 70%; the abstract does not separate anti-PDGF, anti-TGF-beta2, and combination effect sizes.
Exogenous PDGF and TGF-beta2 each increased contraction by about 20% at 100 ng/mL; antibodies blocked these effects with P<0.01.

entities.name: IL-10
observations: In a human RPE/bovine retinal explant organ-culture model, IL-10 alone decreased RPE-mediated retinal contraction by 63% versus untreated controls.

entities.name: Anti-PDGF antibody
observations: Neutralizing antibody conditions involving PDGF reduced RPE-mediated retinal contraction by up to 70% versus untreated controls; the abstract does not provide the anti-PDGF-alone effect size.

entities.name: Anti-TGF-beta2 antibody
observations: Neutralizing antibody conditions involving TGF-beta2 reduced RPE-mediated retinal contraction by up to 70% versus untreated controls; the abstract does not provide the anti-TGF-beta2-alone effect size.
